```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="chest_with_lid">
  <link name="base">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.25" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="20.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.42" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyy="1.20" iyz="0.0" izz="1.02"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.25" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.45 0.38 0.50"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_base">
        <color rgba="0.45 0.30 0.15 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.25" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.45 0.38 0.50"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="lid">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.2666667" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="8.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.1344" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyy="0.3428" iyz="0.0" izz="0.2667"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.2666667" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.45 0.38 0.05"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_lid">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.38 0.18 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.2666667" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.45 0.38 0.05"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Joint frame: hinge along the back edge; axis is +X (roll). -->
  <!-- When closed, lid is rotated so its inner face points upward and it rests atop the base. -->
  <joint name="lid_hinge" type="revolute">
    <origin xyz="0 -0.19 0.50" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="lid"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="-1.57079632679" upper="1.57079632679" effort="50" velocity="2.0"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.2" friction="0.05"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Set the lid pose relative to the joint origin via its link geometry:
       lid box thickness along +Z (0.05 m). In the lid link frame, the lid
       is defined flat; joint rotates it about the hinge line (+X axis) at Z=0.50,
       with the lid resting initially closed by the joint default transform.
       URDF does not include an explicit "home" pose, so we align via rpy below.
  -->
  <gazebo reference="lid">
    <turnGravityOff>false</turnGravityOff>
  </gazebo>

</robot>
```
